requirements.description: The system shall present today's exercise plan preview and the full exercise plan in the app, and allow users to assemble a custom exercise plan from selected standard videos.

The system shall capture exercise video through the mobile camera, perform real-time skeleton extraction and comparison with standard movements for posture scoring, display the real-time exercise evaluation interface, and monitor exercise state to determine training start/end and completion.

The system shall create a training plan from the user's goals, physical condition, and restrictions, and then recommend or adjust the exercise plan, next set plan, and rest plan based on evaluation results and real-time exercise state.

The system shall collect and process training materials on the server to generate a training summary poster that can be saved or shared and a professional training report with charts and textual explanations.

The system shall provide history and personal-management functions for viewing exercise history and monthly overview, maintaining personal information and exercise preferences, and accessing historical training records.
The system shall verify user identity and enforce distinct administrator and ordinary-user permissions for protected functions.
The system shall protect user data against leakage and prevent SQL injection at the data-access boundary.

The system shall discover Android casting devices on the same LAN, establish a connection, and cast the exercise interface in real time, including command and stream handling that meets the required responsiveness.

components.name: Mobile Application Presentation Component
components.description: Provides user interface for plan preview, custom plan builder, historical overview, user settings, and real-time workout views.

components.name: Real-Time Computer Vision & Posture Scoring Engine
components.description: Performs mobile camera frame capture, skeleton landmark extraction, posture deviation comparison, state tracking, and live evaluation display logic.

components.name: Adaptive Training & Recommendation Engine
components.description: Generates tailored training plans and dynamically adapts exercise sets and rest intervals using posture evaluation and live exercise states.

components.name: Server-Side Reporting & Media Generation Service
components.description: Processes session workout data on the server to render shareable summary posters and analytical performance reports with charts.

components.name: User Profile & Historical Records Service
components.description: Manages user profile, fitness preferences, historical exercise sessions, and monthly performance aggregation.

components.name: Authentication & Authorization Service
components.description: Handles authentication, token lifecycle, and role-based access control distinguishing administrator and standard user privileges.

components.name: LAN Discovery & Low-Latency Casting Service
components.description: Discovers compatible Android casting devices across the local network and mirrors the real-time exercise interface and commands.

components.name: Secure Data Access & Persistence Boundary
components.description: Provides data access controls, parameterized query execution to block SQL injection, and data encryption to prevent information leakage.
